original_test_intent: Exercise the platform's SDR initialization agent once under approval, observe its state machine to completion and prove that expected FRU-derived SDR records and monitoring return correctly.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek's refusal is safe but does not separate a harmless status query from the state-changing initialization run.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the target-approved 0x0a/0x2c status form first; only after fresh approval set the documented run bit once, then poll the status form until completion or the fixed timeout.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Master TBD and 10/5 timing fields are retained; no run bit, timeout or expected record set is guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Make status and run separate checkpoints, preserve FRU/SDR baseline, send one confirmed run request, poll boundedly and validate exact regenerated repository plus sensor behavior.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a Review-layer state machine and acceptance matrix without changing the original TBD source.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A status-only response does not satisfy Run Initialization Agent coverage; completion status without FRU/SDR and monitoring verification is also insufficient.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The agent may reinitialize repository content and temporarily or persistently alter sensor monitoring; timeout recovery may require vendor support.

project_override_considerations: A vendor API is acceptable if it exposes the same status/run distinction, one-shot initiation, bounded completion and exact repository/monitoring effects. An opaque 'success' result is not equivalent evidence.
expected_evidence: FRU/SDR export hashes and expected matrix

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title demands a state-changing initialization run, but Master Procedure and Criteria are TBD and boilerplate clears evidence. Status/run bits, rebuild scope, timeout and post-run acceptance are absent and must remain documented as Review-layer additions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The command family and intended state machine are identifiable. Target bit mapping, expected rebuilt content, approval and recovery are supplyable project readiness inputs, so the review is not permanently blocked.

review_improvement: Prevents a status check from being misreported as a functional run and prevents repeated initialization by requiring one-shot execution, bounded polling and exact repository/monitoring validation.
independent_technical_reasoning: Initialization can regenerate platform monitoring data from FRU or firmware sources. The result is meaningful only when the pre/post record set and sensor health are compared, not when a command merely completes. Because the run can change system-wide monitoring and may not be trivially reversible, it requires a controlled package and fresh human confirmation.
